metadata.description: Three-synchronous-machine balanced-congestion IEEE-9 case. Conventional generators are located at N1, N2, and N3; G_IEEE2 is restored at 300 MW and 52.20 EUR/MWh. Total hourly PV availability retains the 35% N6 / 65% N8 split. The N6 export corridor L46/L69 is limited to 180 MW and the N8 corridor L98/L78 to 210 MW so both renewable nodes have material BESS congestion-relief value.
